required_contract: Q4 sweep multiplicity <=1.25 through rows1024 with exact per-output K16 association and strict fallback

rows1024_single_workgroup_geometry.constraint: waves * row_tiles_per_wave >= 64 row tiles; preserving 48-column ownership needs three output tiles

measured_ladder.mechanism: existing strict 256-row parent rollback at rows288

measured_ladder.result: leaf up to -16.28%, full rows536 wall +0.73%; rejected

named_blocker: At rows1024, exact single-sweep workgroup ownership is exhausted at the hardware maximum 1024 threads/32 waves and is 57.6% slower. Splitting ownership across workgroups requires inter-workgroup synchronization or FP32 partial spill/reduction; the measured LDS-spill prototype is already 55.1% slower, and no grid-wide synchronization exists inside the registered strict primitive. Therefore the <=1.25 full-range Y1 flatness contract cannot be met by this kernel family on gfx1151.
sized_remaining: The retained rows288-384 band moves frozen C8 only +0.83% to 239.658 tok/s. Y0 requires 19.1% wall reduction to reach 305.847; the remaining exact one-sweep family is blocked at rows536/1024 and cannot cover that gap.
decision: Close Y1 with retained rows288-384 partial win and measured blocker above rows384. Proceed to Y2/Y3 family and issue-wall tracks.
